hypothesis: H1: a small library of goal types (<= 30) and decomposition METHODs (<= 50), with <= 10 primitive interpreters (SOP constructs and engines), covers most of the owner's book problems by composition alone; the model only fills frames and chooses methods, it never invents reasoning (it never writes a formula, a rule of its own beyond the problem's stated rules, or an answer).
phase: Phase 1 tests the LIBRARY with the frame-filler on tier good (deepseek-v4.1-flash, reasoning effort medium, max_tokens 32000, temperature 0, proxy response cache on). Phase 2 (tiny as frame-filler on the frozen library) is designed, not run without the owner's go.
library: config/knowledge/formalizer-methods-v1 (research layer, chat false): fp_ facts for primitives, goal types and methods (match text, slots, decomposition, solver, calculate formulas and clue templates as data). Seed before any dev problem is read: 7 primitives (calculate, rank, deduce, constraints, schedule, abduce, justify), 14 goal types, 30 methods. Interpreters: tools/eval/method-library/primitives.mjs; every node executes as one SOP circuit through an Agent turn on the product's engines.
sample: 300 problems of datasets_sources/books/eval/items.jsonl (local only), 43 per book (42 for world), split by section family: a book's family key is the coarser of first tag and section; families ranked by a seeded hash (seed ml-split-1) alternate between dev and held-out; no held-out family is used while building. Excluded: formalization regression cases, seen.jsonl, and the 16 problems read while designing the harness (state/method-library/design-read.jsonl). Result: dev 153 (22 per book, world 21), held-out 147 (21 per book). Ids in state/method-library/split.json (hash 62e14278ac360fbd). Sealed suites are never read.

procedure.dev_growth: Three stages in dev order (round robin over books): dev1 = dev[0..30), dev2 = dev[30..90), dev3 = dev[90..153). good sees the problem, the registry of numbers and the worked solution; it fills a method tree from the current library or proposes new methods (executed as candidates). After each stage the controller reviews proposals: generalizes (no domain words), merges duplicates, keeps reusable ones, adopts them into 0040-methods-grown.sop with their stage. One repair round per problem on machine errors.
procedure.freeze: After dev3 the library is frozen. dev-final: all 153 dev problems rerun with the frozen library (no new methods, worked solution shown) for the coverage curve and reuse.
procedure.held_out: held: the 147 held-out problems with the frozen library, WITHOUT the worked solution (primary). held-sol: the same with the worked solution and no new methods (secondary: library adequacy separated from good's frame-filling skill).
procedure.scoring: Exactly one outcome per problem: SOLVED, PARTIALLY_FORMALIZED, AMBIGUOUS, MISSING_INFORMATION, MISSING_CONCEPT, MISSING_METHOD, UNSUPPORTED_PRIMITIVE, CONTRADICTORY, WRONG (executed, not matching gold). Gold comparison deterministic for numbers, yes/no, names and ordered names when the shapes agree; otherwise a judge on tier medium (match | partial | mismatch) that sees the question, the reference answer and the executed answers only. Rules in tools/eval/method-library/score.mjs (classify).

criteria.supported: held-out SOLVED >= 60% AND coverage curve saturates (the last 10 methods in order of entry add < 5% of dev coverage) AND median method use >= 5 problems (SOLVED problems of dev-final and held, every library method counted, unused ones as 0) AND held-out WRONG <= 10%.
criteria.invalidated: held-out SOLVED < 35% OR the methods needed grow roughly linearly with problems (new adopted methods per dev problem in dev3 >= 0.75 times that of dev1, i.e. no decline) OR MISSING_METHOD dominates held-out failures (> 50% of non-SOLVED held-out problems have MISSING_METHOD as outcome or as the block of a partial formalization).
criteria.inconclusive: anything in between; the report names the limiting criterion.

metrics: Per set and book: outcome counts; failure causes; held-out SOLVED with a Wilson 95% interval; coverage curve (dev SOLVED problems whose executed methods are all among the first k methods; seed methods ordered by first use in dev order, then adopted methods in order); method reuse; nodes per solved tree; constants used; flags (a deduce question stated as a fact). Cost: calls, cache hits, tokens, USD from OpenRouter usage.cost.
stopping: Small first: dev1 (30) is run and reviewed before dev2 and dev3. Stop and fix the harness (not the library) if more than 20% of dev1 problems end with no readable tree or an infrastructure failure. No rerun of held-out after it has been run (one measurement). Budget ceiling 40 USD for the whole phase.
deviations: 2026-10-02 dev1: harness fixes before any library decision: an unreadable repair answer keeps the first tree; a repeated fact is stated once (validator stated_duplicate). dev1 was replayed from the proxy cache after the fix (3 new calls).

2026-10-02 dev2: a thinking loop that spends the 32000-token budget with no answer (2 of 60) is asked once more with reasoning effort low (a new request, never a truncated answer); a constraints frame without claim or selection is an existence check.

Interpreter modes added while reviewing dev proposals (code, counted in the report as capability growth of the primitives, not as methods): abduce ask=discriminate, constraints ask=count (enumeration by exclusion), justify mode=structure, calculate series (a formula over position 1..count).

2026-10-03, before any held-out call: added a frame-faithfulness audit (tier medium, one pass) of every SOLVED problem whose frames carry facts, rules, tables, clues, conditions or constants: faithful | background | answer_encoded. Reported as 'strict SOLVED' (SOLVED and not answer_encoded) and 'faithful SOLVED' (SOLVED and faithful) next to SOLVED; the preregistered criteria still use SOLVED; the verdict names the difference.
dev-final and held-sol run with the worked solution shown but proposals off (--solution --no-propose); held runs without the solution.
